notablePrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in their hand.
description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Jeska's Will and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least six {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
